changelog: Improve exact-owner cleanup across player controls, downloads, notifications, settings and sharing. Stale transfer approvals and queued callbacks now remain inactive after disable, navigation or owner replacement; fresh sessions remain usable. Harden atomic settings imports and preserve local-only credentials and state. Align injected controls with CloudStream sizing and focus ownership. Keep retired options unavailable and Font Scale hidden and runtime-disabled without deleting saved values. Verification: complete off-device suite plus isolated native-host and loopback regressions; physical playback, audio effects, Discord rendering and LAN device transfer remain unverified.
message: Dev build v875 - ownership and transfer lifecycle hardening
